claim_ceiling: This audit establishes Definition registry closure for the indexed 85-version queue and records remaining semantic boundaries. It does not establish carrier conformance, consumer activation, migration execution, publication, release, or deployment.

findings.condition: All 85 Definition versions that were pending in the authority and migration candidate trees are admitted by one exact decision overlay.
findings.remediation: Use the live registry and current lookup for canonical resolution.

findings.condition: All 70 reconstructed CyberAlchemy v2 Definition versions are admitted with their exact projections and source selectors preserved.
findings.remediation: Retain the reconstruction evidence and source-admission overlay with the admitted registry.

findings.condition: Four identities retain candidate.1 as admitted history and select their corrected candidate.2 versions as current.
findings.remediation: Resolve these identities through current_lookup unless an exact historical version is required.

findings.condition: The formerly open Workflow dependency for the single-checkpoint definitions is satisfied by the already admitted Craft/DomainSpec Workflow definition.
findings.remediation: Keep the Workflow definition current or re-evaluate dependent definitions when it is superseded.

findings.condition: Append-Only Event Ledger is admitted as a specific pattern; the broader generic ledger primitive remains intentionally unresolved and has no queued Definition artifact.
findings.remediation: Use the admitted append-only pattern where it applies; create and review a separate generic-ledger Definition only if a real cross-domain need emerges.

findings.condition: Definition admission does not admit proposed carriers or activate Artifact Types, profiles, relation kinds, derived surfaces, migrations, or runtimes.
findings.remediation: Validate and authorize each downstream consumer through its own authority route.

findings.condition: The reconstructed Axiom Definition binds the exact D53 bytes preserved in migration execution 0044. The current v2 D53 section has evolved, so this admitted candidate is historical reconstruction rather than a projection of the latest v2 text.
findings.remediation: Author a successor Axiom Definition if the current v2 D53 semantics should replace the admitted reconstructed version.
